examples.title: House and Sun
examples.description: A small landscape drawn with BASIC 3.5's own graphics commands, BOX, CIRCLE, DRAW and PAINT; press any key to return to text.

examples.title: Polygons
examples.description: Say how many sides, from 3 to 12, and BASIC 3.5's CIRCLE command draws that polygon by stepping round a circle; 0 stops.

examples.title: Whack-a-Mole
examples.description: Fifteen moles pop up over the number keys 1 to 9; press the right number before each one ducks back down.

manuals.title: Commodore Plus/4 User's Manual
manuals.note: Setting up, the built-in 3-plus-1 software and the BASIC 3.5 encyclopedia. PDF scan.
